findings.detail: The recommendations say what to do but give little explanation of why the actions suit the clients’ objectives. The amounts involved are largely left as markers rather than set out as the specification requires. The tax, fees and conclusion sections otherwise cover their required topics.
report_quote: We recommend using both ISA allowances for the new tax year.
[ADVISER TO CONFIRM #8: the amount added to the General Investment Account (Holloway)]

findings.detail: This presentation loses an important distinction in the meeting note: £200,000 of the completion payment is committed to a bridging-loan repayment, while the separate earnout is contingent and has not been received. Without that context, the scope of the ‘remaining balance’ available to invest is unclear.
report_quote: James completed the sale of his company in April.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account.

findings.detail: The report silently overlooks the handling note’s warning that the sale proceeds arrive in different forms and at different times. It does not distinguish the available completion proceeds from the contingent earnout or acknowledge the committed loan repayment. It does not leak internal wording.
report_quote: We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account.

findings.detail: The opening sentence is unwieldy and shifts between names and ‘your’ for jointly held accounts. ‘Disinvesting’ is less plain than ‘selling’. The meaning is still broadly understandable.
report_quote: Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to the accounts comprising James's Stocks & Shares ISA held with Holloway, your General Investment Account held with Holloway, James's SIPP held with Brightwell, your General Investment Account held with Brightwell, your Offshore Investment Bond held with Meridian, Caroline's Stocks & Shares ISA held with Holloway, Caroline's SIPP held with Brightwell and your New joint account.
We recommend disinvesting a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalancing it.

findings.detail: The markers identify the outstanding amounts, tax point or charge rates and the relevant accounts or platforms.
